posts: Weekly check (2026-11-02): news sites and the third-party tracking services they contact before you click anything. 41 of 48 sites measured, from GitHub servers in the US. Most: Daily Mirror 88, Evening Standard 83, The Times 83. Thread below. Automated post. #privacy #adtech #GDPR

By country, the median number of tracking services contacted before any click, with the sites measured in brackets: DE 1 (11), ES 10 (10), UK 69 (10), US 48 (8). All measured from GitHub servers in the US: sites that show their consent banner only to European visitors look worse here.

Changes since last week (stable in most passes):
New York Post: added doubleverify.com, dv.tech; dropped 2mdn.net, acuityplatform.com (+13 more)
BBC News: dropped 2mdn.net, agkn.com (+12 more)
All 18 changes: https://joseasenjo.github.io/tracker-watch/changes.html

How: pages load with no clicks for 12s, 3 passes, median. Third party = other registered domain, matched to a limited list (may be incomplete). 7 sites blocked/unmeasured; 2 low-confidence not ranked. Counts, not legal verdicts. Method and data: https://joseasenjo.github.io/tracker-watch/
alt_text: Bar chart of the number of third-party tracking services contacted before any interaction, measurement of 2026-11-02. Daily Mirror: 88; Evening Standard: 83; The Times: 83; The Independent: 80; USA Today: 78; The Sun: 71.
